description: Uploads GarminRunerz workouts to a Garmin Connect account through the unofficial Garmin Connect web API, and manages race events on its calendar. Supports creating, updating, scheduling and deleting workouts; creating, reading, listing, updating and deleting race events; searching Garmin's race catalogue and adding its races to the calendar; and importing a GPX course and attaching it to a race.
releaseNotes: 1.5.0: adds Garmin's race catalogue and courses over the token path. Catalogue: new IRaceCatalogueService / TokenRaceCatalogueService (SearchAsync over GET /race-search/events with RaceCatalogueQuery, GetAsync of the shareable record returning null on 404, SubscribeAsync and UnsubscribeAsync on /calendar-service/event/{uuid}/subscription) registered by AddGarminConnectTokenUploader(); IGarminRaceEventManager gains SearchCatalogueAsync, GetCatalogueRaceAsync, SubscribeToCatalogueRaceAsync (subscribe, then read back) and UnsubscribeFromCatalogueRaceAsync, plus a DeleteRaceEventAsync(userKey, raceEvent) overload that routes on the record (unsubscribe when it has a ShareableEventUuid, delete by id otherwise). A subscribed catalogue race cannot be deleted or read by its event id (Garmin answers 404 to both, verified live): remove it through the subscription route. Courses: new ICourseService / TokenCourseService (ImportGpxAsync as a multipart POST /course-service/course/import of a .gpx, CreateAsync as POST /course-service/course with the web client's save template and the parsed track, GetAsync returning null on 404, DeleteAsync with a 429 "not yet ready" retried 3 times 3 s apart on an injectable TimeProvider) registered by AddGarminConnectTokenUploader(); IGarminRaceEventManager gains ImportCourseFromGpxAsync (import, then save; private by default), GetCourseAsync, DeleteCourseAsync and AttachCourseAsync (GET the event, set CourseId, PUT the full record, GET again), and GarminRaceEventManager a course service factory overload. RaceEvent.CourseId set before CreateRaceEventAsync is sent through; courseId is honoured on create and on the full-record PUT (verified live). Every member added to IGarminRaceEventManager has a default implementation (NotSupportedException for the catalogue and course-service members, delegation otherwise: AttachCourseAsync is built on GetRaceEventAsync and UpdateRaceEventAsync, the record DeleteRaceEventAsync overload on UnsubscribeFromCatalogueRaceAsync and DeleteRaceEventAsync by id), so implementors written against 1.4.0 keep compiling. DEPRECATED: EnsureRaceEventAsync, RaceEventMatcher, RaceEventMatch, RaceEventResult and RaceEventMatchResult are business policy (what counts as the same race), not Garmin API; they are [Obsolete] and unchanged in behaviour, and will be removed in 2.0.0. Compose ListRaceEventsAsync, SearchCatalogueAsync, SubscribeToCatalogueRaceAsync and CreateRaceEventAsync in the application instead. Requires GarminRunerz.Workout.Models 2.2.0 for CatalogueRace, GeoPoint and the course models. IGarminConnectionManager and IWorkoutUploadService are unchanged. 1.4.0: adds race events on the Garmin Connect calendar over the token path (calendar-service). New IRaceEventService / TokenRaceEventService (ListAsync, GetAsync returning null on 404, CreateAsync, UpdateAsync as a full-record PUT, DeleteAsync) registered by AddGarminConnectTokenUploader(), and new per-user IGarminRaceEventManager / GarminRaceEventManager (ListRaceEventsAsync, GetRaceEventAsync, CreateRaceEventAsync, UpdateRaceEventAsync, DeleteRaceEventAsync, and the idempotent EnsureRaceEventAsync: one list over Date-1..Date+1 ranked by the pure RaceEventMatcher, create only when no open event with the same name is on the date or the day next to it, returning RaceEventResult(Event, Created, Match, SameDayOthers)) registered by AddGarminConnectionManager(), sharing IGarminConnectionManager's exception contract (GarminReconnectRequiredException on a dead token, GarminAuthenticationException on a temporary refresh failure, one refresh-and-retry on 401). Client-side checks mirror Garmin's hard failures (blank name, partial start time, non-positive target, unknown eventType unless allowUnknownEventType). Requires GarminRunerz.Workout.Models 2.1.0 for the RaceEvent model. Additive, no breaking change.
